question: کل ملا کر کس نے زیادہ خرچ کیا، سلمى آل ثاني نے یا مريم العتيبي نے؟
gloss: who spent more in total, Salma Al Thani or Maryam Al Otaibi?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name_en FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.name_en IN ('Salma Al Thani', 'Maryam Al Otaibi') GROUP BY c.name_en ORDER BY SUM(o.total_aed) DESC LIMIT 1
predicted_sql: SELECT CASE WHEN c1.name_ar = :customer_name_ar_1 THEN 'c1' WHEN c1.name_ar = :customer_name_ar_2 THEN 'c2' ELSE NULL END AS customer, SUM(o.total_aed) AS total_spending FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c1 ON o.customer_id = c1.customer_id LEFT JOIN customers AS c2 ON o.customer_id = c2.customer_id WHERE (c1.name_ar = :customer_name_ar_1 OR c2.name_ar = :customer_name_ar_2) GROUP BY customer HAVING SUM(o.total_aed) > 0 LIMIT 200
raw_output:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN c1.name_ar = :customer_name_ar_1 THEN 'c1'
        WHEN c1.name_ar = :customer_name_ar_2 THEN 'c2'
        ELSE NULL
    END AS customer,
    SUM(o.total_aed) AS total_spending
FROM 
    orders o
JOIN 
    customers c1 ON o.customer_id = c1.customer_id
LEFT JOIN 
    customers c2 ON o.customer_id = c2.customer_id
WHERE 
    (c1.name_ar = :customer_name_ar_1 OR c2.name_ar = :customer_name_ar_2)
GROUP BY 
    customer
HAVING 
    SUM(o.total_aed) > 0
